newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 14.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 14.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 18.54 points to close at 7274.21, amid sagging bond prices.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index lost 3.97 points to 1,084.55.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5178/88 a dollar and 2.1201/18 per 100 yen at around 0045 GMT, after ending Kuala Lumpur trading on Tuesday at 2.152/62 and 2.1115.42, respectively.

* Auto stocks lost ground again on Tuesday on worries the yen will continue to rise against the ringgit, as dollar/yen rate weakens. In New York on Tuesday, the dollar closed lower at 118.55/65 yen from 119.10/20 previously. Dollar was quoted at 118.68/78 at 0125 GMT in Asia.
* Ekovest says its associate company has been awarded a 345 million ringgit university design and construction job in Sabah state.
* On Wednesday, DRB-Hicom chairman Saleh Sulong will deliver speech at a company function at 1000 local time (0200 GMT).
